StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Verified EDraw student account profile isolated to the owning authenticated user.

uid.description: Owner authentication UID matching the document ID.

edrawId.description: Server-allocated student eDraw ID in EDID-XXXX format.

email.description: Normalized registered email address (PII, strictly owner-only).

college.description: Name of the student's college or institution.

studentDetails.description: Student department, roll number, or academic year details.

registrationStatus.description: Finalized registration status after email verification and server ID allocation.

verified.description: Whether the student's email address has been verified.

emailVerifiedAt.description: Server timestamp when email verification completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

LearningProgressRecord.title: LearningProgressRecord
LearningProgressRecord.description: Per-student EDraw study progress record stored under the student's profile.

ownerUid.description: Owner authentication UID matching the parent student document.

learningSeconds.description: Total active study time in seconds.

completedModules.description: Bounded list of completed module IDs (max 20).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest progress sync.

RegisteredEmailClaim.title: RegisteredEmailClaim
RegisteredEmailClaim.description: Immutable unique email lock document keyed by SHA-256 hash of normalized lowercase email to prevent duplicate registrations.

emailHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized lowercase email matching the document ID.

uid.description: Owner authentication UID that registered this email.

edrawId.description: Allocated student eDraw ID associated with this email claim.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the email claim was created.

/students/{studentUid}.description: Private per-student profile document containing PII strictly isolated to the owning user.

/students/{studentUid}/progress/{progres.description: Student learning progress subcollection gated on parent student document ownership.

/registeredEmails/{emailHash}.description: Immutable per-email uniqueness index keyed by SHA-256 email hash so duplicate email registrations are rejected.
